about_short_description.short_description: UpLink is built to securely request, track, and review volumes of document requests.

product.name: UpLink Document Request Workflow
product.description: A secure platform to send document requests, allow clients to upload documents, review them with AI assistance, and approve validated files.

product.name: UpLink AI-Powered Document Analysis
product.description: An AI-driven tool that analyzes lengthy documents quickly, answers specific questions with source references, and provides editable summaries for review and export.

product.name: UpLink Bulk Document Analysis
product.description: A service that pre-validates client documents at scale using AI to improve sample quality and reduce manual review time.

product.name: UpLink Integration with DataSnipper Platform
product.description: A feature that automatically syncs approved client documents from UpLink into the DataSnipper Platform to support end-to-end workflow automation.
